stem.text: A longitudinal wave has vibrations parallel to the direction of transfer of energy by the wave.
The wave can be represented on a graph showing the variation of the displacement of the particles with distance from the source.
Which point on the graph is the centre of a compression?

stem.alt: Graph of displacement against distance from source, with a sinusoidal wave curve. Printed labels: direction of transfer of energy (arrow); displacement away from source; displacement towards source; distance from source; 0; points labelled A, B, C and D on the curve.
